tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs kyi thub pa'i rgyal tshab dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung rabs rin po che'i bris thang bzhengs tshul ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ dang po la/ rten gyi gtso bo la seng ge'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma zla gdan la bla ma sa skya pa chen po sku mdog mi sha kha las cung zad sngo tsam dbu la spyi thor yod pa'i mdun 'brel ba/ rgya sma ra dang bcas pa dkar po mur gong gi dbu skra 'bur med pa phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi mtheb mdzub sbyar ba'i pad dkar gyi yu ba bzung zhing snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba/ g.yon pus steng mchog sbyin zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung la hor l+h+wam nag po gsol ba/ na bza' dkar po phu dung can/ sku rags dkar po dma' bar bcings pa/ phyi ber thul dkar po 'ja' 'od kyi dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i steng g.yas g.yon la so sor rigs pas dpyad pa'i sprin 'ja' tshon ljon shing ri brag yul ljongs la sogs pa gang mdzes kyi khrod du/ ang rim bzhin gdung gi thog ma/ (1)spyi ring / (2)g.yu ring / (3)g.yu se rnams dpe nang bzhin bong rgyal gyi cha lugs la l+h+wam 'bogs gsol zhing gzhon sha mdzes pa'i nyams ldan/ (4)ma sangs spun bdun gyi tha chung ma sangs spyi rje/ (5)thog tsha dpa' bo stag (6)klu tsha stag po 'od can/ (7)g.ya' spangs skyes/ (8)'khon bar skyes rnams dbu la dar dkar gyi thod/ na bza' phu dung kha dog dkar ser dmar ljang sngon po sogs ci mdzes phyag phu dung gcig nang du gcig bcug pa'am/ yang na mnyam bzhag yang na g.yas thugs kar skyabs sbyin/ g.yon dbu steng mchog sbyin rnams gang babs/ zhabs rdor skyil lam sems skyil gang 'thad/ ༈ gnyis pa la/ rten gtso seng khri la slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo sku mdog mi sha kha dkar ba dbu skra nag po g.yas 'khyil/ phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kha/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten/

nang gos dmar po phu dung can/ sku rags kong thig phyi ber thul dkar po/ zhabs sems skyil gzhon sha mdzes nyams/ (1)dkon pa rje gung stag gam dpal po che mi sha kha dkar ba blon po'i cha lugs na bza' ljang khu phu dung can/ dar sngon gyi thod/ zhabs sems skyil/ phyag phu dung gcig nang du gcig bcug pa/ (2)klu dbang rab byung gi cha lugs stod 'gag med mi sha kha cung zad dmar ba zhal rgya dang ag tshom nag po cung zad yod pa/ dbu la paṇa zhwa rtse ring dmar po/ sku bem ser po/ g.yas chos 'chad g.yon mnyam bzhag phyag dpe/ (3)rdo rje rin chen gzhon sha dkar mdangs dbu skra nag po shin tu thung ba zhal rgyan nag po phran bu zhal 'dzum pa/ snyan gnyis la gser gyi a long / na bza' nang dkar po stod gos sngon po phu dung can sku bem dmar po'i smad dkris pa/ g.yas sa gnon rag 'phreng / g.yon mnyam bzhag thod pa bdud rtsi gang ba/ (4)'gro tsha bdun gyi drug pa shes rab yon tan sku sha smug nag bgres nyams shin tu che ba/ spyan 'bru tshugs dbu skra sngo gro 'ba' mgo ring ba ag tshom dang smin ma sngo gro/ snyan gnyis la dung long / sku 'gag dkar po/ phu dung can stod cha gong gsol dpung khebs sogs dmar po/ sku sham dkar po sku rags rgya tshos/ de steng na bza' phu dung sngon po/ sku bem dmar po/ g.yas thugs kar phur bu g.yon rag 'phreng / (5)yon tan 'byung gong mtshungs las gzhon nyams yin nam snyam zhing mngon rtogs gsal kha ma rnyed/ (6)tshul khrims rgyal po sku sha dmar ba bgres nyams cung zad yod pa/ dbu skra sngo gro sa chen ltar/ ga bcas rgya tshom sngo gro cung zad/ na bza' nang dmar po/ steng mchin kha phu dung can/ sku rags nag po sku bem dkar po/ mgul la rag 'phreng nyis bskor/ g.yon thugs kar thod 'phreng g.yas de 'og nas 'dzin tshul/ (7)rdo rje gtsug tor ram gtsug tor shes rab gzhon sha dkar ba/ dbu skra nag po sil bu/

sku 'gag dkar po/ sku stod dmar po/ sku sham dkar po/ sku rags nag po/ sgom thag dmar po'i ga shal la seng ldeng phur chung gsum btags pa/ stod gos ljang gu phu dung can/ sku bem dur khos/ g.yas kha phub rdo rje/ g.yon thugs kar gser phreng / snyan g.yas gser gyi a long / g.yon g.yu/ rgya l+h+wam gsol zhing rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs/ dge skyabs sku sha dmar mdangs cung zad khro ba/ dbu skra ga bcas sa chen lta bu rgya ag tshom sngo gro/ snyan gnyis la dung long / na bza' nang nag po phu dung can/ sku rags dmar po/ stod gos phod kha mchin kha/ rdor gong dmar po/ g.yon thugs kar thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin cing / g.yas mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi 'thor tshul/ ༈ gsum pa la/ rten gtso seng khri pad zla'i gdan la rje btsun rin po che mi sha kha dkar ba dbu skra dkar po thung ngu zhal rgya sum rim zhes pa'i/ dang po dbu skra nas 'gram pa'i mtha' bskor te 'khor mor 'brel ba/ gnyis pa snyan thad nas rtsa ba'i rgya las gyes te mkhur 'dzum gyi thad du 'ongs shing / de nas thur du song ba rtsa ba'i rgya la 'brel ba/ gsum pa ni zhal gyi ya mchu nas bskor te zhal 'gug gnyis nas thur du 'phyangs ba rtsa ba'i rgya la 'brel ba/ ma mchu'i 'og gi spu yang thur du song nas rtsa ba'i rgya la 'brel ba/ na bza' sa chen dang 'dra/ g.yas thugs kar rdo rje/ g.yon sku pang du kā li gru g.yon mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po yu ba brgyad gzhogs rtsa ba rdo rje phyed pa steng du rdo rje rgya gram de steng bum pa de steng mi mgo skam po gsum brtsegs pa la kha dog sngo dmar dkar/ de steng rdo rje dkar po phyed pa'i rengs pa rdo rje rgya gram gyi 'og nas 'phan rtse gsum pa dang ḍā ma ru dang dril bu rdo rje 'phyang ba/ zhabs skyil krung phyed pa'i bzhugs stangs hor l+h+wam mnabs pa/ bgres nyams che ba/ (1)dge mthong bgres nyams dmar mdangs cung zad khro ba/

ga che zhing lhag ma lcang lo bshig pa ring po rgya ag tshom dkar/ na bza' dkar po'i steng na phod kha sngon po/ sku bem ser po/ g.yas phur phu thugs kar rtse gyen brtan/ g.yon bhan+dha/ rol pa'i 'dug stangs/ (2)bal po gzhon sha dmar ba cung zad khro nyams dbu skra nag po ring zhing sil bu/ zhal rgyan nag po cung zad/ na bza' mchin kha'i steng na ljang gu phu dung can/ sku bem dmar po g.yas phur bu/ g.yon ban+dha/ zhabs g.yon bskum zhing g.yas cung zad brkyang ba bod l+h+wam pa/ (3)shākya blo gros gzhon sha dmar mdangs cung zad khro ba dbu skra nag po sil bu ring ba zhal rgya zhal rgyan nag po cung zad/ na bza' mchan kha/ sku sham dkar po/ sku sked nag steng gos dmar po phu dung can sku bem ser po/ g.yon mnyam bzhag ban nang du g.yas kyi phur rtse bcug pa/ bzhi pa/ shes rab tshul khrims bgres nyams sngo ba zhal cung zad gdengs pa/ dbu skra sngon po thung ngu / rgya ag tshom kham nag na bza' dkar/ sku rags nag stod gos dur kha phu dung can/ sku bem dmar po sku smad la dkris pa/ g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam bzhag pu ti snyan gnyis la shog ril/ (5)dkon mchog rgyal po bgres nyams sku sha dmar ba gangs chen lta bu/ ag tshom rgya sngo gro/ na bza' sku 'gag smug po sku stod ljang / sku sham dkar/ sku rags nag steng gos sngon po phu dung can/ sku bem dkar phyag gnyis sku pang du phyag dpe kha 'byed tshul/ (6)sa chen gtso thang lta bu la seng khri med pa/ (7)kun 'bar rab byung gi cha lugs/ gzhon nyams chos 'chad paṇa zhwa rtse ring dmar po gsol ba gzhan sku bem sogs gang mdzes/ (8)rtse mo gong 'dra seng khri med pa/ bzhi pa la/ rten gtso khri'u shing nag po la khyel bzhugs kyi sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta rab byung gi cha lugs zhal gdong dkyus ring zhing dkar ba dbu dpral dang shangs kyi rtsa ba'i sbrel mtshams na nyag med par thad dkar song ba/ mdzod spu dkar po/

spyan dkyus ring ba dbu la sa zhu gsol lag thur du 'phyang ba/ phyag thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgyas pad+ma'i yu ba nas bzung zhing snyan g.yas g.yon thad kar me tog kha phye ba'i g.yas na ral gri g.yon na pu ti sku la chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba zhabs rjen/ mu stegs kyi skra rab byung zhig gis bzhar tshul dang sa paṇa gyi sku 'khril zhig tu rab byung zhig gis chos gos gding ba lhung bzed chu tshags rnams lag tu thogs nas mu stegs la sprod tshul/ (1)rje btsun gong mtshungs la seng khri med pa/ (2)dpal chen 'od po gzhon sha dkar ba dbu skra rtse mo lta bu/ ag tshom rgya nag cung zad yod pa/ na bza' mchin kha phu dung can/ mgul la dar mdud ser po/ sgom thag dmar po'i ga shal/ sku rags dmar po stod gos ljang gu phu dung can/ phyag gnyis kyis ban 'phreng 'dzin pa/ hor l+h+wam phag sna gsol ba/ (3)sa paṇa gong mtshungs la 'khri shing med pa pad zla'i gdan/ (4)zangs tsha gzhon nyams dmar ba dbu skra nag po thung ngu ag tshom rgya nag cung zad/ na bza' dkar po phu dung can/ sku rags nag po/ pho rag dmar po/ stod gos dmar po phu dung can/ mgul la rag phreng / g.yas thugs kar gri gug g.yon gdan brten/ hor l+h+wam nag po/ sems skyil/ snyan g.yon la shog ril/ (5)'phags pa 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin la 'khri shing med pa/ (6)phyag na shin tu gzhon pa gzhon nyams bsod rtse lta bus dbu la hor zhwa nag po/ sku la na bza' dmar po steng gos sngon po phu dung can sog rgya'i cha lugs/ zhabs rdor skyil phyag 'phreng ba/ (7)rin chen rgyal mtshan rab byung gi cha lugs gzhon nyams dkar ba chos 'chad/ (8)ye shes 'byung gnas sngags pa'i cha lugs gzhon nyams/ ༈ lnga pa la/ rten gtso 'khri shing la chos rgyal 'phags pa khyel bzhugs rab byung gi cha lugs sku mdog cung zad dmar ba gzhon nyams can/ zhal ras zlum zhing rgyas pa 'bur zhing gshong sa gshong ba/

mkhur khug cung zad/ spyan gnyis 'bur ba mdun gyi dbu skra'i mtshams thad kar yod pa/ ltag 'bur bcas pa'i dbu zlum zhing rgya che ba/ chos 'chad zhabs rjen chos gos dmar po bsnams pa/ ༈ dharma pā la mi sha kha dkar ba gzhon nyams dbu skra bzhar ba/ na bza' phu dung ljang khu phyi la sku 'gag gi tshul mnabs pa/ sku bem dmar po g.yas thugs kar 'phreng ba g.yon mnyam bzhag rdor skyil/ ༈ rat+na bha drwa bu chung gi cha lugs shin tu gzhon pa'i nyams can dkar ba/ na bza' phu dung can dkar po/ phyag 'phreng ba zhabs sems skyil/ ༈ bzang po dpal rab byung gi cha lugs sku sha che ba/ ༈ bsod nams bzang po gzhon nyams dkar ba na bza' ljang khu phu dung can/ sku bem dmar po/ zhabs sems skyil/ phyag chos 'chad/ ༈ rat+na shrī gzhon nyams na bza' phu dung can dkar po gsol ba/ gzhon ma cha lugs rnams ci mdzes/ ༈ kun dga' blo gros rab byung gzhon nyams ci mdzes/ 'di yan spyi la dbang bsgyur gyi gdung rabs/ de nas bzhi thog bla brang gi gdung rabs kyi thog ma/ ༈ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa dar ma dpe bzhin/ nam mkha' bshes gnyen gzhon nu/ na bza' phu dung can gang mdzes/ ༈ rten gtso seng khri za 'og 'bol steng bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan rab byung gi cha lugs zhal gdong ring zhing dbu gtsug na gtsug tor lta bu'i 'bur che ba 'khor ba gnyis dang mgrin pa 'bur ba zhal 'gug gnyis cung zad 'bur ba/ spyan dkyus ring ba/ sku mdog mi sha kha/ phyag sa gnon mnyam bzhag zhabs rjen rdor skyil/ chos gos gsol ba/ ༈ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gzhon nyams rab byung cha lugs ci mdzes/ ༈ ta dben kun snying rab byung gi cha lugs bgres nyams ci mdzes/ ༈ gu shrī blo gros rgyal mtshan rab byung cha lugs bgres nyams cung zad gzhan ci mdzes/ ༈ grags pa blo gros rab byung cha lugs bgres nyams che ba ci mdzes/ ༈ kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan rten skya bo gzhon nyams na bza' phu dung can ci mdzes/

༈ kun dga' dbang phyug dge bsnyen gyi cha lugs can dar ma ci mdzes/ lcang lo yod pa/ ༈ blo gros dbang phyug rab byung cha lugs bgres nyams ci mdzes/ 'di yan bzhi thog bla brang pa'i gdung brgyud/ ༈ rten gtso seng khri za 'og gi 'bol la/ theg chen kun dga' bkra shis rab byung gi cha lugs zhal gdong zlum zhing rgyas pa/ spyan gnyis dang zhal dkyil gshongs ba/ spyan 'bras chung zhing dkyus ring ba/ shangs kyi rtsa bar phra ba mur gong gi thad tsam gnyis dang spyan mtha'i thad tsam gnyis dang dpral steng gi thad rnams 'bur ba/ sku mdog dkar ba phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol zhing / zhabs rjen rdor skyil/ chos gos sogs ci mdzes/ rin chen sgang bla brang gi gdung brgyud kyi thog ma/ ta dbon kun dga' nyi ma rab byung dar yol chos gos sogs ci mdzes/ don yod rgyal mtshan rab byung gzhon sha ci mdzes/ chos rje bla ma gtso thang bzhin las gdan khri rgyas pa med/ nyi ma rgyal mtshan gzhon nyams na bza' phu dung can mtshan dang / kun dga' snying po gnyis ka lcang lo gnyis dge bsnyen gyi cha lugs yin nam snyam/ rin chen rgyal mtshan rab byung bgres nyams can mdzes/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan rab byung gzhon nyams can ci mdzes/ ༈ rten gtso gong mtshungs za 'og 'bol steng byang chub sems dpa' rgyal sras sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros dpe bzhin/ kun dga' blo gros legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rab byung bgres nyams zhabs rdor skyil/ phyag g.yas mnyam bzhag g.yon phyag 'phreng dbu la sa zhu lag 'phyang ba gsol ba chos gos sogs ci mdzes/ 'di yan lha khang bla brang pa'i gdung brgyud/ dus mchod bla brang pa'i gdung gi thog ma/ slob dpon nyi ma dpal dge bsnyen gzhon nyams/ kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dge bsnyen gzhon nyams/ bla chen bsod nams blo gros rab byung gi cha lugs dar ma ci mdzes/

grags pa rgyal mtshan rab byung gi cha lugs kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros rab byung gzhon nyams/ rnam sras rgyal mtshan dge bsnyen dar yol/ ༈ rten gtso sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa a mes la dpe bzhin/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan rab byung bgres nyams phyag 'phreng 'dzin pa/ kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rab byung dar ma ci mdzes/ nam mkha' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan rab byung dar ma ci mdzes/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dge bsnyen gzhon nyams can/ nam mkha' rin chen dpal bzang po rab byung dar ma ci mdzes/ nam mkha' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dge bsnyen cha lugs dar yol sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dpe bzhin/ ༈ rten gtso 'khri shing la 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang gi cha lugs dpe bzhin/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rab byung dar yol sa lo lta bu/ 'jam dpal grags pa sngags 'chang gzhon sha/ tshe brtan bkra shis gsang sngags dar yol/ kun dga' bsam 'grub gsang sngags dar yol/ kun dga' bde legs bkra shis sngags 'chang cung zad bgres nyams/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub dpe bzhin/ tshe dbang rdor sogs bsod nams rgyal mtshan sngags 'chang gzhon nyams/ rten gtso seng khri pad zla'i gdan la sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis dpe bzhin/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gam 'jig rten rgya hor sngags 'chang grags blo bzhin las zhal rgya med pa/ byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan 'di la dpe zhig 'byor na dang ma 'byor na rab byung dar yol/ ngag dbang lhun grub sngags 'chang gzhon nyams/ bsod nams bstan 'dzin dbang po byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rab byung gzhon nyams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug pa zhal gdong bzhin la sku sha tsho ba spyan sgyir mo 'bur ba g.yas rdo rje thugs kha/ g.yon kā li rag phreng dkris pa/ zhabs skyil krung /

dbu la sa zhu rgya mdud ma gsol ba/ ngag dbang nor bu bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po gsang sngags bgres nyams can kun dga' rin chen 'dra ba las/ zhal 'gugs gnyis la gnyer ma gyen lang re yod pa zhal rgyan dkar po cung zad/ kun dga' tshe dbang rig 'dzin sngags 'chang gzhon nyams/ ngag dbang nor bu rgyal mtshan zhal ras zlum zhing gzhon sha spyan 'bur ba shangs zur ba rab byung gi cha lugs dbu la paṇa zhu rtse ring dmar po gsol ba g.yas thugs kar chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam bzhag pu ti chos gos sogs ci mdzes/ 'di yan rtse gdong pa'i gdung rgyud rdzogs/ ༈ rten gtso seng khri pad+ma zla gdan la kriṣ+ṇa sa ra'i lpags steng rdo rje 'chang dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sngags 'chang cha lugs dpe bzhin la cung zad bgres nyams dbu skra sngo gro mig mthong yid gsal bzhin/ phyis byon dus mchod bla brang pa'i gdung rgyud sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ sngags 'chang mthu stobs dbang phyug sngags 'chang kun dga' dbang rgyal gzhon nyams sku sha tsho ba sngags 'chang gi cha lugs/ thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis rnams so so'i dpe bzhin/ de ltar gdung rabs kyi bris thang bco lnga dang / kha skong grangs bsab pa'i phyir/ ༈ rten gtso sbyin bdag ste rim bzhin yab rje gong mtshungs/ thar rtse nam mkha' bsam 'grub dpe bzhin/ ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mig mthong bzhin/ rje btsun ma kun dga' bstan pa'i nyi ma mig mthong bzhin/ sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grags chen slob dpon bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mig mthong bzhin/ chos rje bsod nams blo gros dge slong bgres nyams/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas ye shes mig mthong bzhin te bka' drin che ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma bdun/

chos skyong mgon po lcam dral e ka dza ṭī bcas bram gzugs pu tra bcas/ ༈ rten gtso za 'og 'bol steng rdo rje rgya gram bcas kyi gdan gnyis la sbyin bdag mched gus 'dud kyi tshul pus btsugs thal sbyar gyis gnas pa'i mdun du gser gyi maṇ+ḍal re re/ gzhan ma lcog dmar rdor dril sogs bla chas dkyus bzhin/ phyis 'byung 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu mu tig bstar la brgyus pa ltar 'byon 'gyur gyi rten 'brel mtshon byed sbyin bdag sngags 'chang gi drung du za 'og 'bol gdan rdo rje bcas pa byis pa gzhon nu mdzes pa'i tshul can gsum phyag tu bum pa/ nor bu/ shing tog sogs 'dzin pa mtha' skor grwa bu slob kyi 'khor bcas sbyin bdag gnyis kyi steng du/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug phyag chos 'chad can dkyus bzhin shongs tshe de mtshams bde mchog nag po pa dpe bzhin/ kyai rdo rje/ de'i g.yas g.yon gang 'thad du/ tshe dpag med/ sgrol dkar/ rnam rgyal/ de 'og zhal dkar po tshe 'phel dpe bzhin/ de 'og rnam sras dkar po tshe 'phel dpe bzhin/ de 'og dkar bdud lcam dral/ de 'og nor lha dmar po skor gsum gyi gtso bo ku ru kul+les byas pa rnam thos sras/ dzam+bha la rnams/ ༈ rten thams cad kyi gnas gsum du 'bru gsum dbu can lañtsa gang bde/ sa chen gyi dpral bar oṃ sarba bi d+yā swāhā/ dbu can/ mgrin par oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ dbu can/ thugs ka nas zhabs yan la/ oṃ āḥn mo lo ki shwa ra ma hā gu ru ā nan+da gar+bha ya hūm̐/ de'i mjug la rten 'brel snying po/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha/ bzod pa dka' thub dam pa sogs dang / 'dod gsol zur gsal bzhin/ de steng spyi ring rgyab tu/ oṃ āḥshi ra dīr+ghaṃ hūm̐/ g.yas g.yu ring la/ oṃ āḥse ro tsa dīr+ghaṃ hūm̐/ g.yon g.yu se la/ oṃ āḥse ro tsa brid+dhā hūm̐/ gtso bo'i g.yas ma sangs rgyas spyi rje la/ oṃ āḥmā tri shud+dhā sarba swa mi hūm̐/

g.yon dpa' bo stag la/ oṃ āḥwī bhā bhu hūm̐/ 'og ma'i g.yas stag po 'od can la/ oṃ āḥbyā gh+ra rasmi bā na hūm̐/ g.yon g.ya' spang skyes la/ oṃ āḥ.a mā si ma pūr+pan+na hūm̐/ dbus ma 'khon bar skyes la/ oṃ āḥdro ha sī myur+pan+na hūm̐/ ༈ gnyis pa slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo la gzhan thams cad gong dang 'dra ba las mtshan sngags/ oṃ āḥn mo badz+ra tik+ṣa na ā tsar+ya rat+na puṇ+ya grā ya hūm̐/ de steng dbus dpal po che la oṃ āḥm hā shrī hūm̐/ g.yas klu dbang la oṃ āḥn gan+d+re rak+ṣi ta hūm̐/ g.yon rdo rje rin chen la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ri rat+na hūm̐/ gtso bo'i g.yas shes rab yon tan la/ oṃ āḥprañdzā gu ṇa hūm̐/ g.yon yon tan 'byung gnas la/ oṃ āḥgu ṇa kā ra hūm̐/ 'og g.yas tshul khrims rgyal po la/ oṃ āḥshrī la rā dza hūm̐/ g.yon rdo rje gtsug tor la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐/ dbus dge skyabs la/ oṃ āḥshū bha sha ra ṇa hūm̐/ ༈ gsum pa rje btsun rin po che la gzhan thams cad gong mtshungs las/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ āḥn mo ma hā yo gi shwa la bhaṭ+ṭa ra kā kirta dh+wa dza ya hūm̐/ steng dbus dge mthong la/ oṃ āḥshū bha/ g.yas bal po la/ oṃ āḥdro ha shā sa na n+de pa la hūm̐/ g.yon shākya blo gros la/ oṃ āḥshākya ma ti hūm̐/ gtso bo'i g.yas shes rab tshul khrims la/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā shī la hūm̐/ g.yon dkon mchog rgyal po la/ oṃ āḥrat+na rā dza hūm̐/ 'og g.yas sa chen la/ oṃ āḥ.a nan+da gharba hūm̐/ g.yon kun 'bar la/ oṃ āḥnan+dha dz+wa la hūm̐/ dbus bsod rtse la/ oṃ āḥpuṇ+ya gra hūm̐/ ༈ bzhi pa sa skya paṇa chen la gzhan gong mtshungs las/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ āḥn mo mañdzu gho ṣa bhū mi paṇ+ḍi ta a nan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ya hūm̐/ steng dbus rje btsun/ oṃ āḥkirti dh+wa dza hūm̐/ g.yas dpal chen 'od po la/ oṃ āḥm hā shrī pra bha hūm̐/ g.yon sa paṇa la oṃ āḥnan+da dh+wa dza hūm̐/ g.yas bzang tsha la/

oṃ āḥpuṇ+ya dh+wa dza hūm̐/ g.yon 'phags pa la/ oṃ āḥm ti dh+wa dza hūm̐/ 'og g.yas na gdan la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrat+na dh+wa dza hūm̐/ dbus ye 'byung la/ oṃ āḥdz+nyā na ka ra hūm̐/ ༈ lnga pa 'phags pa la gong mtshungs las/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ āḥn maḥtri dhā tu dhārma s+ya ra dza ā d+ya rat+na ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ya hūm̐/ steng dbus dharma pha la la/ oṃ āḥdharma pha la hūm̐/ g.yas rat+na bha drwa la/ oṃ āḥrat+na bha drwa hūm̐/ g.yon bzang po dpal la/ oṃ āḥbha drwa shrī hūm̐/ gtso bo'i g.yas bsod nams bzang po la/ oṃ āḥpuṇ+ya bha drwa hūm̐/ g.yon rat+na shrī la/ oṃ āḥrat+na shrī hūm̐/ 'og g.yas la kun dga' blo gros la/ oṃ āḥ.ā nan+dha ma ti hūm̐/ g.yon nam mkha' legs pa la/ oṃ āḥg gā na su bha hūm̐/ dbus nam mkha' bshes gnyen la/ oṃ āḥ.ā kā sha ku mi ta hūm̐/ ༈ drug pa chos rje bla ma dam pa la/ gzhan 'dra ba las mtshan sngags/ oṃ āḥn ma shrī wan+dha saṅgu ru sarba dz+nyā/ pun+ya dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa ya hūm̐/ steng dbus nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la/ oṃ āḥ.ā ka sha dh+wa dza hūm̐/ g.yas ta dben kun rig la/ oṃ āḥ.ā nan+da rat+na hūm̐/ g.yon blo rgyal la/ oṃ āḥm ti dh+wa dza hūm̐/ gtso bo'i g.yas grags blo la/ oṃ āḥkirti ma ti hūm̐/ g.yon kun blo la/ oṃ āḥnan+da ma ti dh+wa dza hūm̐/ 'og g.yas kun dbang la/ oṃ āḥ.a nan+de shwa ra hūm̐/ g.yon blo bzang la/ oṃ āḥm te shwa ra hūm̐/ ༈ bdun pa theg chen la gzhan mtshungs mtshan sngags/ oṃ āḥn mo ma hā ya na dharma s+ya rā dza ā nan+da maṅga la dh+wa dza bha drā ya hūm̐/ steng dbus ta dben kun nyi la/ oṃ āḥ.ā nan+da sur+ya hūm̐/ g.yas don rgyal la/ oṃ āḥ.a mo gha dh+wa dza hūm̐/ g.yon chos rje la/ oṃ āḥpun+ya dh+wa dza hūm̐/ gtso bo'i g.yas nyi rgyal la/ oṃ āḥsūr+ya dh+wa dza hūm̐/ g.yon kun rgyal la/ oṃ āḥ.ā nan+dha dh+wa dza hūm̐/ 'og g.yas nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la/ oṃ āḥgā ga na dh+wa dza hūm̐/

g.yon mthu stobs dbang po la/ oṃ āḥnu dhā ba bā le shwa ra puṇ+ya dh+wa dza shrī bha drā hūm̐/ ༈ brgyad pa sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje la gzhan 'dra ba las/ mtshan sngags oṃ āḥn maḥku la sarba sa ti bhu mi paṇ+ḍi ta lo tsā mañdzu gho ṣa ā nan+da pu ṇ+ya kirti dh+wa dza shrī bha drā ya hūm̐/ steng dbus rgya gar sher bzang la/ oṃ āḥman+t+ra dh+wa ra siṅka ta pra dz+nyā bha drā hūm̐/ g.yas blo gros rgyal mtshan la/ oṃ āḥm hā pa ti badz+ra dh+wa ra ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/ g.yon grags rgyal la/ oṃ āḥkirti dh+wa dza hūm̐/ gtso bo'i g.yas kun legs la/ oṃ āḥ.a nan+da su bha ka ra hūm̐/ g.yon kun rgyal la/ oṃ āḥ.a nan+da dh+wa dza hūm̐/ 'og g.yas chos rgyal la/ oṃ āḥdharma rā dza hūm̐/ g.yon blo rgyal la/ oṃ āḥm ti dh+wa dza hūm̐/ ༈ dgu pa sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po la gzhan 'dra la mtshan sngags/ oṃ āḥn mo ma dh+wa ra gu ru mā ra sa bha la ha ren+d+ra bā gin+d+ra ā nan+da rat+na maṅga la kirti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa ma hūm̐/ steng dbus theg chen la/ oṃ āḥ.ā nan+da maṅga la dh+wa dza shrī bhā drā hūm̐/ g.yas chos rgyal la/ oṃ āḥdharma dh+wa dza hūm̐/ g.yon rdo rin la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rat+na hūm̐/ gtso bo'i g.yas bsod bkras rgyal chen la/ oṃ āḥ.ā nan+da maṅga la dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ g.yon bde bkras la/ oṃ āḥswasti maṅga la hūm̐/ 'og g.yas bsod rgyal la/ oṃ āḥpuṇ+ya dh+wa dzin hūm̐/ g.yon shākya seng ge la/ oṃ āḥshākya singha hūm̐/ ༈ bcu pa 'jam mgon dbang po la gzhan 'dra ba las mtshan sngags/ oṃ āḥn ma siṅghe shwa ra pad+ma kā ra mañdzu gho ṣa me tre shrī bī gin+da pa ṇ+ya kirti dhā dza shrī bha drwa ya hūm̐/ steng dbus don phul rgyal mtshan la/ oṃ āḥ.ar+tha sid+dhī dh+wa dza hūm̐/ g.yas bsam rgyan la/ oṃ āḥmaḥbya sid+dhī dh+wa dza hūm̐/ g.yon kun bkras la/ oṃ āḥ.ā nan+da maṅga la hūm̐/ gtso bo'i g.yas kun rgyal la/

oṃ āḥ.ā nan+da dh+wa dza hūm̐/ g.yon kun snying la/ oṃ āḥ.a nan+da gha ba hūm̐/ 'og g.yas rin rgyal la/ oṃ āḥrat+na dh+wa dza hūm̐/ g.yon chos rgyal la/ oṃ āḥdharma dh+wa dza hūm̐/ ༈ bcu gcig pa byang sems grags pa blo gros la gzhan 'dra ba las/ mtshan sngags oṃ āḥn mo ma hā bo dhi satwa shin+ti rak+ṣa tra dzo la man+t+ra dhā ra kīrti ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa ya hūm̐/ steng dbus kun blo la/ oṃ āḥ.a nan+da ma ti su bha ka ra dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/ g.yas nyid dpal la/ oṃ āḥsūr+ya shrī hūm̐/ g.yon kun legs la/ oṃ āḥnan+da su bha ka ra dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/ gtso bo'i g.yas bsod blo la/ oṃ āḥpu ṇ+ya ma ti hūm̐/ g.yon grags rgyal la/ oṃ āḥkīrti dh+wa dza hūm̐/ 'og g.yas kun legs la/ oṃ āḥ.a su bha ma ti hūm̐/ g.yon nam rgyan la/ oṃ āḥbai3 shra ma ṇa dh+wa dza hūm̐/ ༈ bcu gnyis pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams la gzhan 'dra gcig las/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ āḥn maḥku la tsi sarba man+t+ri la phra bhu wī gin+d+ra a nan+da su pu ṇ+ya kirti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa s+ya pa da ya hūm̐/ steng dbus chos rgyan la/ oṃ āḥdharma dh+wa dza hūm̐/ g.yas kun blo la/ oṃ āḥnan+da ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/ g.yon nam legs la/ oṃ āḥ.ā kā sha bha dh+wa dza hūm̐/ gtso bo'i g.yas nam rgyan la/ oṃ āḥg gā na dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/ g.yon nam rin la/ oṃ āḥ.ā kā sha rat+ni shrī bha drwa hūm̐/ 'og g.yas nam bkras la/ oṃ āḥ.ā kā sha maṅga la dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa ya swāhā/ g.yon sa lo la/ oṃ āḥmañdzu gho ṣa ā nan+da pu ṇ+ya kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa ya hūm̐/ ༈ bcu gsum pa 'jam dbyangs bsod dbang la/ gzhan 'dra ba las mtshan sngags/ oṃ āḥn ma shrī badz+ra gar+bha wā gin+d+ra puṇ+ya shwa ra ra kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa ya hūm̐/ steng dbus ngag gi dbang phyug la/ oṃ āḥwā gi shwa ra kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/

g.yas 'jam dpal la/ oṃ āḥmañdzu shrī kirti hūm̐/ g.yon tshe bkras la/ oṃ āḥmañdzu gho ṣa ka sha ār+tha sid+dhi budhā yu tiṣ+ṭha maṅga la dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/ gtso bo'i g.yas kun bsam la/ oṃ āḥ.ā nan+da ma n+ya sid+dhi hūm̐/ g.yon kun bde la/ oṃ āḥ.ā nan+da swasti maṅga la hūm̐/ 'og g.yas kun bsod la/ oṃ āḥmañdzu gho ṣa a nan+da pu n+ya ni ra bho ga hūm̐/ g.yon tshe dbang la/ oṃ āḥyuḥsha ṣa ri ka pu n+ya dh+wa dza hūm̐/ ༈ bcu bzhi pa sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis pa gzhan 'dra ba las/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ āḥn maḥka ru ṇi ke shwa ra wā gin+d+ra ā nan+da maṅga la/ kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa ya hūm̐/ steng dbus rgyal hor la/ oṃ āḥlo ke shwa ra hūm̐/ g.yas byams dbang la/ oṃ āḥmai tri wā gin+d+ra ma ṇi pu ṇ+ya ni ra bhā ga hūm̐/ g.yon ngag dbang la/ oṃ āḥwā gin+d+ra pu ṇ+ya ni ra bho ga hūm̐/ gtso bo'i g.yas bsod bstan la/ oṃ āḥpu ṇ+ya shā sa na dha ra in+d+ra mai tri dharma dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/ g.yon ngag nor la/ oṃ āḥwā gin+d+ra ma ṇi pu ṇ+ya wa sha s+ya rā dza hūm̐/ 'og g.yas kun tshe la/ oṃ āḥ.a nan+da yu in+d+ra ku la bha ra hūm̐/ g.yas rgyan drung la/ oṃ āḥwā gin+d+ra ma ṇi dh+wa dza hūm̐/ ༈ bco lnga pa rtsa ba'i bla ma gzhan 'dra ba las mtshan sngags/ oṃ āḥn moḥmasatri tri ka la/ sarba bud+dhā s+ye at+ma ta shrī bhu mi paṇ+ḍu ma hā man+d+ra dhā gu ru sarba dz+nyā wā gin+d+ra ā nan+da pu ṇ+ya rat+na maṅga la kirti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa ya hūm̐/ steng dbus sngags 'chang chen po la/ oṃ āḥwā gin+d+ra a nan+da rat+na maṅga la kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/ g.yon bsod nams dbang po la/ oṃ āḥmai tri shi wa gin+d+ra in+d+ra kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/ g.yon grags pa blo gros la/ oṃ āḥkīrti ma ti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/ gtso bo'i g.yas sgar chen la/ oṃ āḥ.ā nu bhā ma a shwa ra kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/

g.yon kun 'bring la/ oṃ āḥwā gin+d+ra ā nan+da a shaṃ dza ya hūm̐/ 'og g.yas zhabs drung a mes la/ oṃ āḥwā gin+d+ra ā nan+da pu ṇ+ya kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/ g.yon bsod nams dbang phyug la/ oṃ āḥ.ā nan+da pu ṇ+ya shwa ra kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/ dbus kun dga' bkra shis/ oṃ āḥwā gin+d+ra ā nan+da maṅga la kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa hūm̐/ ༈ bcu drug pa sbyin bdag la/ bzod pa dka' thub bzhag pa tsam ma gtogs cho ga rnams mtshungs shing / 'dod gsol zur gsal dang ming sngags/ ma ma bhu mi paṇ+ḍu shākya bik+ṣu wā gin+d+ra ā nan+da mā ti bud+dhā shā sa na s+ya dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa shrī bo na saṅgu ru na arti lathi na tsha sarba sid+dhī me pra yats+tshan+tu swāhā/ steng yab rje la/ oṃ āḥn mo wā gin+d+ra a nan+da pu ṇ+ya rat+na maṅga la kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa ya hūm̐/ thar rtse sku zhabs la/ oṃ āḥn mo ga gā na ma n+ya sid+dhi nan+pa nu bya ñtsa no dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa ya hūm̐/ zhabs drung rin po che la/ oṃ āḥn mo wa gin+d+ra ā nan+da su bha kā ra yā na ba ra shwa pa na s+ya dh+wa dza shrī bha drwa ya hūm̐/ chos rje bsod nams blo gros la/ oṃ āḥn mo dharma swā mi pu ṇ+ya ma ṇi ye hūm̐/ bir+wa pa la/ oṃ āḥbi+ir+wa pa hūm̐/ 'khor lo bde mchog la/ oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshe dpag med la/ oṃ tad+ya thā/ a pa ri mi ta a yur+dz+nyā na hrīḥhūm̐ bh+rūm̐ swāhā/ sgrol dkar la/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swāhā/ dkar po tshe 'phel la/ oṃ bh+rūṃ ṇi a yu khe swāhā/ mgon po la/ oṃ ma hā ka la hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum chen la/ oṃ e ka dzā ṭi hūm̐ phaṭa/ lha mo la/ oṃ ma hā kā la de wi hūm̐ phaṭa/ bram gzugs la oṃ tsa turmu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ rig byed ma la/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswāhā/ tshogs bdag la/ oṃ āḥgin hūm̐ swāhā/ 'dod rgyal la/ oṃ āḥṭak+ki rā dza hūm̐ swāhā/ ༈ bcu bdun pa sbyin bdag la/

gong bzhin las mtshan sngags/ ma ma bh+rūṃ badz+ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ rnam rgyal la/ oṃ a mṛ ta ā yur+dha te swāhā/ zhal dkar po tshe 'phel la/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ ḍoṃ ba ni ku ru ye swāhā/ dkar bdud la/ oṃ badz+ra shin+tiṃ pad+ma kurtaṃ bh+yo/ oṃ sarba mā ra kriṣ+ṭha ka la ma la dha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnam sras la/ oṃ bai3 shrā wa ṇī ye swāhā/ dzam+bha la la/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swāhā/ ༈ na mo gu ru bh+ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i chu gter las/ /dga' ba'i rang bzhin chu skyes rkang gnyis pa/ /snying po'i ze'u 'bru legs bshad dri bsung can/ /rje btsun brtse ba chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /kun nas mdzes pa'i zhal dkyil zla rgyas 'dra/ /dga' bzhi mthar son lhan skyes ye shes ngang / /nges don snying por skal ldan grol mdzad pa'i/ /mtshan dpe 'bar ba'i sku yi snang brnyan la/ /'od gsal gdung dang 'khon rigs dang po yi/ /sku yi bkod pas legs bskor bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che/ /spyi dang bye brag 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i/ /bshad sgrub chos kyi bya ba gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /phyogs bcur dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen mchog rnams dang / /khyad par rgyal ba gnyis pa sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa'i rgyud 'dzin dri med rigs kyi chos/ /slob tshogs dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /rgyal bstan 'byung khungs dpal ldan sa skya pa'i/ /bshad sgrub chos kyi snang ba rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /dge 'dun bsti gnas lha chen bde gling sogs/ /dgon gnas dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang bka' yi pho nya ba/ /nag po lcam dral gnyen mgon nor skyong zung / /las mgon lnga dang dkar bdud phur srung sogs/ /bstan srung mthu stobs rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /yul phyogs 'dis mtshon mtha' klas nor 'dzin gzhir/ /lha klus dus su char 'bebs 'bru bcud 'phel/

/nad mug 'khrug rtsod kun zhi rdzogs ldan gyi/ /zla shel lta bur rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /gnod sems can gyi mi min 'byung po'i tshogs/ /gnod sems spangs shing dge ba'i sems dang ldan/ /gnod bral phan sgrub lhag bsam yar ngo yi/ /zla shel lta bur rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /khyad par dam pa rnams kyi rigs skyes shing / /rjes su 'jug pa kun dga' blo gros che/ /yid dbang gsal zhing tshe bsod longs spyod 'phel/ /rigs rgyud rgyun mi chad par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams bcas kyis/ /khams gsum 'di kun dbang du myur bsdus nas/ /skye dgu kun la mchod sbyin bla med kyi/ /phan bde'i lo thog rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /'jam mgon bla ma sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i/ /gsung gi bdud rtsi skal bzang snang ba'i bcud/ /bstan 'dzin tshad ma'i dgongs 'grel bcas pa la/ /thos bsam sgrub pa 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /'chad pa ngag gi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro/ /rtsom pa nor bu'i phreng ba mtshar du dngar/ /rtsod pa gnam lcags thog mdas rgol ngan 'joms/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /thos pa 'chi med bdud rtsi brgyud la sim/ /bsam pa yid bzhin nor bu'i bang mdzod rgyas/ /sgom pa sku bzhi'i 'bras bu khur du lci/ /bstan pa'i bya ba rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /rnam dag khrims kyi yu ba rab tu brtan/ /smon 'jug sems kyi lhab lhub phyogs bcur g.yo/ /smin grol gdams pa'i nor bu tog tu mdzes/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par mdzad du gsol/ /'dul 'dzin mchog las bslab khrims rnam gsum nos/ /sems dpa' che las byang sems rnam gnyis bzung / /rdo rje 'dzin pas rjes bzung smin grol lam/ /nyams myong grol ba thob par mdzad du gsol/ /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la/ /thabs la mkhas pa'i dam chos gru bzhag nas/ /rnam grol rin chen gling du skyel ba yi/

/ded dpon mchog tu 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog gi bka' lung ltar/ /bdag gi mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /ma rig nag po'i rtsa lag sder bcas pa/ /chos dbyings gnas su sgrol bar mdzad du gsol/ /phyi rol rnam g.yeng bdud kyis mi khyer zhing / /nang du rim gnyis spyod dang mi 'bral ba/ /gsang ba mkha' sbyor yan lag bdun ldan sku/ /ring min myur du thob par mdzad du gsol/ /slar yang gang 'dul sprul pas srid mtha'i bar/ /dbang po'i grangs ldan bzhed gzhung yongs 'du'i shing / /rnam dpyod phrag par rnam rtsen ma la ya'i/ /phyogs bcur 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /mdor na 'di dang phyi ma'i don thams cad/ /yid la re ba ji bzhin myur 'grub nas/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa rin po che/ /srid mthar dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /bsod rtse la/ bde ldan dbang phyug thugs rje'i thig le las/ /dpag med bsod nams mthu las bskrun pa'i sku/ /rtse mo'i ye shes la sogs mthar phyin pa'i/ /dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang sku mthong byed dbang pos mthong na dga'/ /gang gsung thos pa tsam gyis thos don ldan/ /gang thugs dran pas zag med dran pa rnyed/ /mthong thos dran reg tsam gyis dpal ster ba'i/ /sku brnyan yid bzhin nor bu'i mtha' skor du/ /dpal po che sogs mthu chen 'khon gdung gis/ /legs par bskor ba'i ngo mtshar 'phrul bzhengs mthus/ /bu ram shing pa'i sogs gong bzhin/ ༈ rje btsun la/ rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs kyi gtsang chab las/ /legs 'khrungs chu skyes grags pa'i dri bsung can/ /nyon mongs 'dam rdzab las rgyal mtshan ma yis/ /skal bzang bung ba'i dpal la gsol ba 'debs/ /bskyed pa'i rim pas tha mar rnam rtog 'joms/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pas rang byung ye shes brnyes/ /nam yang bde stong rol pas dus 'da' ba'i/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog gi snang brnyan la/

/'jam dbyangs sa skya'i gdung gis bskor ba yis/ /ngo mtshar ri mo'i bkod pa bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /bu ram shing pa'i sogs/ ༈ sa paṇa la/ ye shes me long thugs rje'i rgyun las 'khrungs/ /gzhon nu nyid nas sngon gyi bag chags sad/ /nges par 'jam dbyangs mi yi gzugs can zhes/ /snyan grags srid 'dir sgrogs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bzo gso sgra dang tshad ma nang don rig /kun la gang gi blo yis thogs pa med/ /zur phud lnga pa ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshul/ /sa skya paṇa chen gang sku'i ri mo la/ /rje btsun mchog sogs 'jam dbyangs rigs brgyud kyis/ /ngo mtshar bkod pas nyer bskor bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /bu ram shing pa'i sogs/ ༈ 'phags pa la/ ut+pal sngo ldan rigs las sprul pa'i sku/ /blo gros gter chen chos char 'bebs pa'i gsung / /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal yon can/ /bzang po'i mtshan can zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang thugs zab rgyas chos kyi chu gter che/ /srid pa'i dpal 'byor 'khor los bsgyur rgyal bzhin/ /rmad byung yon tan du ma'i mdzod 'dzin pa'i/ /dpal ldan 'phags pa'i sku yi bkod pa la/ /dharma pha la la sogs gdan sa che'i/ /gdung rgyud 'phreng bas legs bskor bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /bu ram shing pa sogs/ ༈ bla ma dam pa la/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen zhing brtse ba las/ /nus mthu gcig bsdus dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /dri med rigs su bsams zhing skur bstan pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung rnam thar bsam yas kyi/ /skyes chen dam pa kun las khyad par 'phags/ /de phyir 'jig rten khams 'dir 'gro kun gyi/ /skyabs gcig chos kyi rgyal po'i sku brnyan la/ /gu shrī nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i/ /bzhi thog bla brang gdung rgyud kyis bskor ba/ /bi shwa karma'i sgyu 'phrul bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /bu ram shing pa'i sogs/ ༈ theg chen la/ mtshungs med rgyal kun sras kyi thu bo pa/

/dhīḥyig las 'khrungs 'jam dpal mi yi zol/ /rlabs chen bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis kyis/ /dpal gyi mngon par mtho la gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs ka'i bdag nyid dpal ldan chos kyi rje/ /sa yi brgya byin mchog gi bka' lung las/ /mngon par mtho bar bsngags pa'i dge mtshon can/ /srid zhi'i rgud sel chos rje'i sku brnyan la/ /ta dben kun dga' nyi ma la sogs pa'i/ /rin sgang bla brang gdung gis bskor ba yi/ /ngo mtshar ri mo'i bkod pa bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /bu ram shing pa sogs/ ༈ sa lo la/ rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /kun dga' legs bshad zab don snying po'i mchog /bsod nams rtse sogs grags pa'i 'od dkar gyi/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan kun tu gzigs pa'i ye shes kyis/ /gdul bya'i blo gros mun pa rab bsal nas/ /bzang po'i lam gyis rgyud kun smin mdzad pa'i/ /rje btsun 'gran bral 'jam pa'i rdo rje la/ /rgya gar sher bzang blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs/ /rin sgang gdung dang ti shrī kun legs sogs/ /lha khang bla brang gdung gis bskor ba yi/ /ngo mtshar du ma'i bkod pa bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /bu ram shing pa sogs/ ༈ sngags 'chang chen po la/ grangs med bskal par mngon du sangs rgyas kyang / /ma dag gdul bya'i snang ngor mkhas grub kyi/ /rnam 'phrul du mas gar bsgyur sa skya pa/ /kun dga' rin chen zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde gshegs kun gyi mthu stobs nus pa'i rgyun/ /gang khyod mi zad rgyun gcig gis drangs pa'i/ /snyigs dus bstan la gnod byed bdud kyi dpung / /phyer 'thag rje btsun mchog gi sku brnyan la/ /theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis sogs/ /lha khang bla brang gdung gis bskor ba yi/ /phun tshogs mig gi bdud rtsi bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /bu ram shing pa'i sogs/ ༈ bsod nams dbang po la/ rgya mtsho'i gling du pad+ma'i spo las 'khrungs/

/o ḍi ya nar rgyal po'i sras skal mdzad/ /bod ljongs 'dre srin gdug pa'i gnya' gnon mchog /pad+ma dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi bka' mchid rab 'bar rdo rje'i phreng / /dregs ldan yongs kyi gtsug tu bsnyil ba yis/ /srid gsum mgon zhes grags pa ljongs 'dir gsal/ /'khrul zhig dbang po mdzes sku'i snang brnyan la/ /don grub rgyal mtshan la sogs lha khang pa'i/ /gdung gis legs bskor ngo mtshar bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /bu ram shing pa'i sogs/ ༈ grags blo la/ 'phags pa'i yul du rgyal po'i rigs las 'khrungs/ /bod yul mun gling dam chos sgron me sbar/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel ba'i mdzad 'phrin can/ /sngags 'chang mchog gi mdzes sku'i snang brnyan la/ /lha khang gdung rgyud kun dga' blo gros dang / /dus mchod bla brang gdung rgyud nyi dpal sogs/ /ngo mtshar bkod pas legs bzhengs dge ba'i mthus/ /bu ram shing pa'i sogs/ ༈ sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams la/ rnam mang ting 'dzin chu klung bye ba brgya/ /zung 'jug rgya mtsho'i klong du 'dres pa las/ /dngos grub nor bu'i 'byung gnas sa skya pa/ /sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen par gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang lha ltar mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku/ /kun dga'i mkhyen rab bsod nams bye ba'i dbus/ /rnam dkar grags pa'i rgyal mtshan mngon mtho ba'i/ /dpal ldan 'phrin las bzang po'i sku brnyan la/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan la sogs dus mchod pa'i/ /gdung gi phreng bas legs bskor bzhengs pa'i mthus/ bu ram shing pa'i/ ༈ bsod nams dbang phyug la/ dpal ldan rigs brgya'i rnam rol kun dga'i mtshan/ /gang gi chos dang rigs sras kun gyi gtso/ /bskal bzang sgron me bzhi pa thub dbang gi /rgyal tshab dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mthong bas yid kyi gdung sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /brtse bas 'khor ba'i 'phrang sgrol spyan ras gzigs/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i 'gran bral rdo rje 'dzin/

/mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag gang sku'i bkod pa la/ /ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs/ /rtse gdong bla brang gdung gis bskor ba yi/ /ngo mtshar ri mo'i bkod la bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /bu ram shing pa'i sogs/ ༈ kun dga' bkra shis la/ gang gis mtshan tsam 'dzin zhing dran pas kyang / /thar pa'i lam la yud kyis 'dren pa po/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa zhes snyan bsgrags pa'i/ /kun dga' bkra shis zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag po sa skya pa/ /'jam mgon mkhas pa'i dbang po grub pa'i rjes/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'gro kun dga' ba'i dpal/ /bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan snang brnyan la/ /'jig rten dbang phyug la sogs rtser gdong pa'i/ /gdung gi 'phreng bas bskor ba bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /bu ram shing pa'i sogs/ ༈ rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ mthu stobs mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rje/ /mi shes smag rum kun 'phrog rang bzhin gyi/ /'od gsal nyin mor byed pa'i dpal yon can/ /bsod nams rin chen zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas zhing grub brnyes sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen/ /legs byas cha shas yongs gang bsil zer gyis/ /skye 'gro'i gdung sel 'jam mgon zla ba'i dbang / /gang sku'i bkod pa 'dren byed dpal ster la/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rje/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen dang / /gang de'i rigs sras dbon sras mu tig phreng / /ngo mtshar phreng bas legs bskor bzhengs pa'i mthus/ /bu ram shing pa'i sogs/ ༈ sbyin bdag la/ dwa na pa ti ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /skye ba dang tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su gzung du gsol/ rje btsun dam pa rnams kyi rigs dbon gyi tha shal ba bdag la dbang po'i grangs ldan brgyud pa dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

bdag gi skye ba 'di dang 'das ma 'ongs da lta ba'i dus dag tu zhe sdang med pa dang / phrag dog med pa dang / gti mug med pas kun nas bslangs shing skyes pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / khyad par du yang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gdung rabs kyi bkod pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i dpal yon can 'di bzhengs pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan rin po che spyi dang bye brag 'khrul zad rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu spyi dang bye brag bdag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po rnams zhabs pad bskal pa'i bar brtan par gyur cig chos grwa chen po thub bstan lha chen gsang sngags bde chen gling e waṃ chos ldan gong dkar rdo rje gdan/ bkra shis chos sde sogs gong ma'i bzhed gzhung dri med 'dzin pa'i 'dus grwa thams cad du'ang bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig yul phyogs 'dis mtshon 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bde legs kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig khyad par du bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta yan chad du nyan thos kyi bslab pa dang 'gal ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa la sogs pa sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig dam pas chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa/ 'khor dang longs spyod mthu dang dbang phyug lung rtogs kyis yon tan la sogs pa legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di la bde blag tu 'grub pa sogs mdor na 'di dang phyi ma'i don thams cad 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/

ka l+yā na war+dhan+tu/ ༈ yang gcig la/ ma ma bhu mi paṇ+ḍu wa gin+d+ra ā nan+da pu ṇ+ya a nu bha wa bā le shwa ra maṅga la kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha a dhiṣ+ṭha na/ hi ta su khā kā ra shā sa na rat+na dā sha war+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha na/ shā sa na dhā ra pu ru ṣad saṅgu ru pā dā tiṣ+ṭhan+tu a dhiṣ+ṭha na saṅga se na war+dha a dhīṣ+ṭha na/ lo ka dhā tu swa sti su bhā war+dhā a dhīṣ+ṭha na/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu swāhā/ bye brag tu yang 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i rigs rgyud dri ma med pa mu tig bstar la brgyus pa bzhin 'byon pa dang byon nas kyang bstan pa rin po che nyi 'od ltar ches cher gsal zhing / 'gro ba kun gyi mgon du 'gyur bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi zhing mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sku/ /sa bcu'i mgon por bsam zhing sgyu 'phrul mkhan/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i rol rtsed sa skya pa'i/ /'jam mgon bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs/ /bdag ni skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /yang dag bla ma dam pa nyer bsten zhing / /mdo rgyud zab mo'i dgongs don rtogs pa dang / /rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byed par shog /thog ma'i dus nas nyon mongs las dbang gis/ /mi dge bgyis dang bgyid du bstsal ba dang / /rjes su yi rangs nyes kun bshags shing bsdam/ /phyin chad rnam smin myong bar ma gyur cig /sbyin dang tshul khrims bsgoms pa las byung ba'i/ /dge 'bras dkar po'i phyogs kyi zla dbang des/ /las nyon sdug bsngal mun chen kun bsal nas/ /tshogs gnyis ku mud rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /khyad par 'jam mgon bla ma sa skya pa'i/ /gdung rabs yongs 'du gsar bu'i me tog 'phreng /

/ri mo'i snang brnyan mtshar du dngar ba'i mthus/ /sa bstan 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag kyang tshe ring nad med chos spyod 'phel/ /rigs rgyud dri med dbyar mtsho ltar du rgyas/ /snyan grags dpal 'byor ngal gsos dbang dang mtshungs/ /bde skyid dpal la spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na 'di phyi'i yid la re ba'i 'bras/ /kun 'grub sa skya'i rje btsun bzhed gzhung rgyun/ /ljongs 'dir mes po'i ral rlung ltar rgyas shing / /bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// ༈ /sku thang dang po'i rten gtso sa chen la/ rdo rje 'chang bla ma sa skya chen po kun dga' snying po la na mo/ de steng spyi ring la/ 'jam dbyangs gdung gi thog ma spyi ring la na mo/ g.yas par g.yu ring la na mo/ g.yon par g.yu se la na mo/ gtso g.yas/ ma sangs spyi rje la na mo/ g.yon dpa' bo stag la na mo/ 'og g.yas/ stag po 'od can la na mo/ g.yon g.ya' spang skyes la na mo/ dbus 'khon bar skyes la na mo/ ༈ gnyis pa'i rten gtso/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams rtse mo la na mo/ steng dbus dpal bo che la na mo/ g.yas klu'i dbang po la na mo/ g.yon rdo rje rin chen la na mo/ gtso g.yas shes rab yon tan la na mo/ g.yon yon tan 'byung gnas na mo/ 'og g.yas tshul khrims rgyal po la na mo/ g.yon rdo rje gtsug tor la na mo/ dbus dge skyabs la na mo/ ༈ gsum pa'i rten gtso/ gsang ba'i bdag po grags pa rgyal mtshan la na mo/ steng dbus dge mthong la na mo/ g.yas 'khon ston bal po la na mo/ g.yon shākya blo gros la na mo/ gtso g.yas shes rab tshul khrims la na mo/ g.yon dkon mchog rgyal po la na mo/ 'og g.yas sa chen kun dga' snying po la na mo/ g.yon gcen kun dga' 'bar ba la na mo/ dbus slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo la na mo/ ༈ bzhi pa'i rten gtso/ sa paṇ+ḍi ta 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/

g.yon grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ gtso g.yas kun dga' legs pa la na mo/ g.yon kun dga' rgyal mtshan la na mo/ 'og g.yas chos rgyal mtshan la na mo/ g.yon blo gros rgyal mtshan la na mo/ ༈ dgu pa'i rten gtso/ sngags 'chang bdud kyi stobs 'phrog ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ steng dbus theg chen chos kyi rgyal po la na mo/ g.yas chos rgyal mtshan la na mo/ g.yon rdo rje rin chen la na mo/ gtso g.yas bsod nams bkra shis la na mo/ g.yon bde legs bkra shis la na mo/ 'og g.yas bsod nams rgyal mtshan la na mo/ g.yon shākya seng ge la na mo/ ༈ bcu pa'i rten gtso/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ steng dbus don grub rgyal mtshan la na mo/ g.yas bsam 'grub rgyal mtshan la na mo/ g.yon kun dga' bkra shis la na mo/ gtso g.yas kun dga' rgyal mtshan la na mo/ g.yon kun dga' snying po la na mo/ 'og g.yas rin chen rgyal mtshan la na mo/ g.yon chos rgyal mtshan la na mo/ ༈ bcu gcig pa'i rten gtso/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ steng dbus kun dga' blo gros legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ g.yas nyi ma dpal la na mo/ g.yon kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ gtso g.yas bsod nams blo gros la na mo/ g.yon grags pa rgyal mtshan la na mo/ 'og g.yas kun dga' legs pa la na mo/ g.yon rnam sras rgyal mtshan la na mo/ ༈ bcu gnyis pa'i rten gtso/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ steng dbus chos rgyal mtshan la na mo/ g.yas kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ g.yon nam mkha' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/

gtso g.yas nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ g.yon nam mkha' rin chen dpal bzang po la na mo/ 'og g.yas nam mkha' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ g.yon sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje la na mo/ ༈ bcu gsum pa'i rten gtso/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ steng dbus ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ g.yas 'jam dpal grags pa la na mo/ g.yon 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' don grub sangs rgyas tshe brtan bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ gtso g.yas kun dga' bsam 'grub la na mo/ g.yon kun dga' bde legs la na mo/ g.yas 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub la na mo/ g.yon tshe dbang hor sogs bsod nams rgyal mtshan la na mo/ ༈ bcu bzhi pa'i rten gtso/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ steng dbus 'jig rten dbang phyug la na mo/ g.yas byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan la na mo/ g.yon ngag dbang lhun grub la na mo/ gtso g.yas bsod nams bstan 'dzin dbang po byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ g.yon ngag dbang nor bu bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po la na mo/ 'og g.yas kun dga' tshe dbang rig 'dzin la na mo/ g.yon ngag dbang nor bu rgyal mtshan la na mo/ ༈ bco lnga pa'i rten btso/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ steng dbus sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po la na mo/ g.yas 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po la na mo/ g.yon sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la na mo/ gtso g.yas sgar chen mthu stobs dbang phyug la na mo/ g.yon kun dga' dbang rgyal la na mo/ 'og g.yas rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la na mo/ g.yon 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug la na mo/
